description: This file implements the NativeJSPlugin class, which manages the lifecycle and initialization of a NativeJS plugin within the WPEFramework. It includes registration, initialization, deinitialization, and information reporting functionalities.

classes.name: NativeJS
classes.description: A class that manages the NativeJS plugin lifecycle, including registration, initialization, and cleanup within the WPEFramework.

methods.name: NativeJS
methods.description: Constructor that sets the singleton instance.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the NativeJS plugin, sets up the native JS interface, and registers it.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up the plugin, unregisters, and releases resources.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns a JSON string with the service name.
